## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated rewrites.
- [ ] Documentation and compatibility notes are updated when needed.
- [ ] Upstream source boundaries and license notices are preserved.
- [ ] No secrets, keystores, personal logs or generated build output are included.
- [ ] The PR describes known limitations instead of claiming more than was tested.
